regime_context: Detector shows a narrowing, non-directional rotation: only 19 of 49 themes are trend-gate eligible (frac 0.39), with AI Infrastructure the leader by score (1.98) but breadth only 0.708 and tagged 'fading'. Gate_helps is true for US history, so the trend discipline is a legitimate de-risking lens, and the one clean lead is Cybersecurity (durability_bar 0.85, breadth 1.0) though it is crowded (z 1.80).
emerging_watch: Watch whether Technology (Equal-Weight) closes the rank gap against AI Infrastructure: XLK currently sits at rank 8 (score 0.66, breadth 0.689, 'trend' Hurst) while the AI Infrastructure leader is tagged 'fading' with sub-0.75 breadth. A confirmed leadership handoff would retire the watch only if XLK's score crosses above smh-linked AI Infrastructure on two consecutive weekly observations, not on a single spike.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only eligible theme combining top-3 momentum rank with the strongest durability profile in the table (durability_bar 0.85, breadth 1.0) and a 'trend' Hurst tag. The crowding flag (z 1.80) is a size-down caution, not a fade. The lead is structural consistency of breadth, not a reflexivity buy trigger.
theses.dissent: With crowding z at 1.80, CIBR is the most extended theme in the table; if the AI-led tape stalls, the most-crowded software names historically de-rate fastest even without a basket-drawdown signal.

falsifier.text: CIBR prints two consecutive weekly closes below its 10-week average before the 20-day check-by horizon.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is the highest-ranked non-tech theme (rank 4, score 1.005) with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, positive breadth (0.727), and no crowding (z 0.83). In a narrowing leadership regime, a non-AI eligible trend theme offers diversification against the AI-heavy leadership without the reflexivity risk of the crowded software leg.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is frequently a coincident expression of commodity-beta or inflation surprises; with 75% of macro narrative flow unscheduled, a demand-shock headline could unwind this trend faster than its breadth suggests.

falsifier.text: XLE posts two consecutive weekly closes below its 10-week average and its rank falls out of the top 10 before the 20-day check-by horizon.

theses.subject: Robotics & Automation
theses.thesis: Robotics & Automation is eligible but carries a 'mean-revert' Hurst tag, sub-0.6 durability (0.56), middling breadth (0.583), and negative crowding z (-0.06). The mean-revert signature means the trend gate has historically provided little drawdown protection on this theme in US history, so an avoid lean is the disciplined read rather than an overweight.
theses.dissent: A sudden industrial-automation catalyst (reshoring capex acceleration) could flip the Hurst regime from mean-revert to trend and render the avoid call conservative relative to a legitimate narrative turn.

falsifier.text: BOTZ prints a 10% gain over any rolling 10-day window and its Hurst tag flips to 'trend' before the 20-day check-by horizon.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
